```{r}
##Logistic Regression

##Loading libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```


```{r}
cvd09_median <- median(wide$CVD09)
cat("CVD09 median threshold:", round(cvd09_median, 2), "deaths per 100,000\n")

train_log <- train %>%
  mutate(CVD09_high = as.factor(ifelse(CVD09 > cvd09_median, 1, 0)))
test_log <- test %>%
  mutate(CVD09_high = as.factor(ifelse(CVD09 > cvd09_median, 1, 0)))

cat("Training class distribution:\n"); print(table(train_log$CVD09_high))
cat("Test class distribution:\n");     print(table(test_log$CVD09_high))
```


```{r}
log_formula <- as.formula(
  paste("CVD09_high ~", paste(feature_cols, collapse = " + "))
)

log_model <- glm(log_formula, data = train_log,
                 family  = binomial,
                 control = glm.control(maxit = 100))

summary(log_model)
```


```{r}
log_prob <- predict(log_model, newdata = test_log, type = "response")
log_pred <- as.factor(ifelse(log_prob > 0.5, 1, 0))

cat("Sample of predicted probabilities:\n")
print(head(round(log_prob, 3), 10))

cat("\nSample of predicted classes:\n")
print(head(log_pred, 10))
```



```{r}
conf_mat <- table(Predicted = log_pred, Actual = test_log$CVD09_high)
cat("Confusion Matrix:\n"); print(conf_mat)

log_accuracy  <- mean(log_pred == test_log$CVD09_high)
tp            <- conf_mat["1", "1"]
fp            <- conf_mat["1", "0"]
fn            <- conf_mat["0", "1"]
log_precision <- tp / (tp + fp)
log_recall    <- tp / (tp + fn)
log_f1        <- 2 * log_precision * log_recall / (log_precision + log_recall)

cat("\nAccuracy: ",  round(log_accuracy,  3), "\n")
cat("Precision:",   round(log_precision, 3), "\n")
cat("Recall:   ",   round(log_recall,    3), "\n")
cat("F1 Score: ",   round(log_f1,        3), "\n")
```



```{r}
log_results <- data.frame(
  Probability = log_prob,
  Predicted   = log_pred,
  Actual      = test_log$CVD09_high
)

# Predicted probability distribution by actual class
ggplot(log_results, aes(x = Probability, fill = Actual)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("0" = "steelblue", "1" = "darkorange"),
    labels = c("0" = "Low Mortality", "1" = "High Mortality")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Logistic Regression — Predicted Probabilities by Actual Class",
    x     = "Predicted Probability of High Mortality",
    y     = "Count",
    fill  = "Actual Class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Confusion matrix heatmap
as.data.frame(conf_mat) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), size = 7, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Logistic Regression — Confusion Matrix",
    x     = "Actual Class",
    y     = "Predicted Class"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Actual vs Predicted bar chart
ggplot(log_results, aes(x = Actual, fill = Predicted)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("0" = "steelblue", "1" = "darkorange"),
    labels = c("0" = "Predicted Low", "1" = "Predicted High")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Logistic Regression — Actual vs Predicted Classes",
    x     = "Actual Class",
    y     = "Count",
    fill  = "Predicted"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
